chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"If the water is the amount of two qullas, nothing can make it impure, and the two qullas are two jars."

key_terms.الْمَاءُ: water as the subject of ritual purity rulings
key_terms.جَرَّتَانِ: two jars, explaining the measure of two qullas
key_terms.قُلَّتَيْنِ: two qullas, a legal measure of water volume

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if water reaches the amount of two qullas?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity of water. It states that when water reaches the measure of two qullas, it is not rendered impure by contact with impurity, and it defines that measure as two jars.
